rotating_reviews: “I’ve never skiied or snowboarded in my life and Basil was the perfect instructor!” Charleigh
“Basil explained everything calmly and clearly, remained patient, and adjusted the pace well to our daughter.” Andreas Steffen
“He taught my three kids over three days, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better instructor.” Hans NorthRider
“My sons learned a lot and had so much fun snowboarding that they didn’t want to stop.” Julio Pinto
“Basil was extremely patient and, with his support, quickly got me up to speed.” Liam Rohner
